dataSource: LOGIS ePermits (epermits.logis.org) — Building, Plumbing, and Mechanical permit records
notes: Electrical permits in Edina route through the MN Department of Labor & Industry rather than the city, so only 82 electrical records (all from July 2011) are on file here — that's a state data-routing quirk, not a gap in Tarn's coverage.
Data is a static extract refreshed manually, not a live city API — the most recent 1–2 months may be incomplete.
summary: Edina is covered by a deep extract from the LOGIS ePermits system: over 90,000 permits spanning Plumbing, Mechanical, and Building — Plumbing records back to 2010 — matched by address. Electrical permits route through the state rather than the city, so coverage there is minimal.
